steps.name: Epilogue ~ A Special Visitor to the Island
steps.objective: Welcome the visitor who has come to see [Hayden] on 「Aie Island」.

lines.text: (Hayden quietly looks up at the sky as unfamiliar presences approach the place she has been watching over.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I have been on this island a long time, but I have never felt anything like this. Marie, we have guests. Let us get ready to greet them.
(Hayden strokes Marie’s head. The doll nods and jumps down from her arms.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: A pleasure to meet you. My name is Mir... Aaaaaah! What is that?!

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Is she not adorable? This is my friend Marie.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Mir, please be quiet.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Hayden has not changed.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: You know everyone, Hayden. Only Mir needs an introduction.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: ...So you all know each other.
(Mir looks over the spirits gathered before Hayden.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: We cannot help knowing. When we open our eyes, the knowledge comes naturally. Though there are occasional exceptions.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: My apologies.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: How does it feel to have come all this way, Narin?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: ...I never imagined visiting another continent. I feel as though I am flying above the clouds.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: You did fly here, though.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hehe, so I did. It is all thanks to Lady Iris and Harmonia. They gave me permission to visit another continent and helped me practice flying.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: That scroll of yours... It has been such a long time since I saw it.
(Narin smiles brightly at Hayden and holds up the scroll.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It is much like your Marie, Hayden. A pity it cannot offer its own greeting, being a scroll.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Since we are having a gathering, is there anything to eat?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I brought some food from Gerda, just in case.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Wonderful! Gerda’s food has never let me down. Ooh, sandwiches!

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Come to think of it, you eat food too, do you not, Narin?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I cannot appreciate its full flavor as humans do, but I sometimes take pleasure in eating.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: A spirit who enjoys the food of living beings... Mir makes that less surprising, but you seem more accustomed to humans than to spirits...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I do not know whether I should thank the vanished Echo for that, but I am content as I am now.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Wow, this is delicious! Gerda’s food really is the best!

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: The others do not eat, so please have as much as you like.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Mir, I will make you something later. I have been studying cooking quite a bit.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I am sorry! I will not eat too much. What can I do? I was born hungry. Ahh...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: My apologies, Mir. I will prepare some fruit next time. And...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Geis, let me explain that. Is everyone here now?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: One person—no! One spirit is still missing.
Nope, I’m here!
(No sooner are the words spoken than the spirit everyone has been waiting for hurries out from the island’s interior.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Zoe, you made it?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: What were those things back there? Dog-like birds? Bird-like dogs? Those demons were sleeping, and they gave me a fright. What brought them all the way out here...?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: They are considered fools even in the Demon Realm. There is no need to worry about them.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Are you sure that’s all right?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: It is fine. You have my word as the island’s spirit, so do not worry.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: All right, then.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: We have been waiting for you, Zoe.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: A new face, too. I’m Zoe. With that way of talking, you must be an old spirit yourself, eh?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I do not know how far back you mean by old, but I have always spoken this way. Hehe.
(As the spirits exchange greetings, Marie, who has been circling Hayden, walks into their midst.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thank you, Hayden.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: This is Marie.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Of course. Marie. Now that everyone has said hello, please listen. I asked you to meet here because there is something I need to tell you.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Harmonia, is this about the necklace you are holding?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: No. Nor has a new inner world opened.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Then...?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I believe he has awakened.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: May I ask who you mean...?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: A spirit of light who waited long for his master without sleeping. He left his voice in eastern Freios for the sake of its living beings...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Where has he been all this time?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: He has been asleep in Orcarium, where he originally belonged.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Orcarium? Isn’t that place all right? What’s the problem?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Someone forced him into sleep, then woke him again. That is why I need your help. It is Lady Iris’s wish as well.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: ...Find out where the Black Moon’s energy is scattering—the energy that spilled onto the earth through the cracks.
